error.message:
newspec-c: failed → failed · product (failed · product (the lane flagged a product issue; part of it is a known gap))
The oracle's cells all pass - 40/40 judged (newspec-c/vis-efs-s17-mic-blocked.spec.ts, desktop Chromium, two runs: getUserMedia rejected with NotAllowedError 'Permission denied', and with NotFoundError 'Requested device not found' / no capture device). In all four boxes - Hospital pre-round editor, Hospital Encounter box, Ask AI sheet, Nursing Home visit box - one Dictate tap after typing 'QA-EFS-17 typed before dictate.' shows 'Microphone access is blocked. Allow the microphone for this site (tap the lock icon in the address bar), or on iPhone/Android open Settings › Round Companion, then tap Dictate again.', the typed line stays in the box, no crash, no raw browser error. Failed only on the known B27 contradiction: in the Hospital pre-round editor the yellow 'Dictation done — review before saving' nudge shows together with the red microphone message in both runs, although nothing was dictated (UAT state 8 guidance). Record-only: with no microphone at all the wording still says 'blocked' / 'Allow the microphone' (Q6, suggestion); the pre-round editor's message is a plain div (Encounter and Nursing Home use role=alert, Ask AI the global role=alert banner). No recording, no model: the browser's own speech recognition was hidden so the app took the cloud engine physicians use (the account keeps its on-device marker), and ai/transcribe:prepareSession was held in the browser (4 calls per run, all 'hold', none reached the server); tripwire: no model call.
Product issue: With the microphone blocked (or missing), tapping Dictate in the Hospital pre-round editor shows 'Dictation done — review before saving' next to 'Microphone access is blocked…', telling the physician to review a dictation that never happened (B27).

testCase.name: [local] S17 Web: microphone blocked, and no microphone at all — every Dictate button explains how to enable it, typed text stays

descriptionHtml:
Bug B27 · P2 · new (partly known)

Failure states give the wrong or no guidance: after an interrupted pre-round save the Encounter tab keeps the physician waiting for the panels while the Pre-Round tab says to tap Save Note; an interrupted Nursing Home Save Note says the text was edited; a red 'disconnected' error stays after dictation recovered; a failed Quick Dictation transcription shows only the raw server error, no '⚠ what to do'; with the microphone blocked it still says 'Dictation done — review before saving'; Post-Round shows 'Finalizing Encounter Data…' forever for a Hospital patient with no note yet

Tickets: TFA-94745 ready for qa · counts as a QA bug: yes · found on: dev + local

Note: Review 2026-10-14 (TFA-94745/92582): EFS/S06: the Encounter tab does say the panels are still being processed; the fault is that the processing had stopped. TC-04/S28: on a 429 the only thing on screen is the raw server error (B17's kind), and S28 covers only the batch (whisper) path, not a gpt-live failure. EFS/S22: 'Dictation done' with the microphone blocked (UAT state 8). EFS/S02 and TC-20/S24: the endless 'Finalizing…' spinner D7 points to.

Other cases of the same bug (counted once): EFS/S06, TC-10/S29, TC-23/S08, TC-04/S28, TC-17/S19

Approach · EFS Empty & Failure States · S17 Web: microphone blocked, and no microphone at all — every Dictate button explains how to enable it, typed text stays

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • U8 Microphone permission denied, or the mic didn't start: an explicit message explaining how to enable it; a denied permission is handled without a crash. (UAT EFS state 8; TFA-94745 state 8; TFA-92570 AC 4)
  • U11 Every state shows a clear, plain-language message in the app's existing style that tells the physician what to do next (retry, enable permission, sign in, check connection). (UAT EFS Expected Result; TFA-94745 AC 1; TFA-94745 AC 5)
  • U12 No state ever shows a blank screen, a crash, a raw error pop-up, or invented content. (UAT EFS intro; UAT 3.4; TFA-94745 AC 2)
  • U13 Nothing the physician dictated or typed is lost in any failure state. (UAT EFS Expected Result; TFA-94745 AC 3)
  • U14 Every state works in both Hospital and Nursing Home, on web, iOS and Android. (UAT EFS Expected Result; UAT 3.3; TFA-94745 AC 6)

Test design technique: Equivalence classes (equivalence) — Check the same rule again with another class of input (Hospital / Nursing Home, other data); every class has to be right.

Given Run 1: browser with microphone permission denied. Run 2: browser with no capture device. Standard fixture

When Type a line, then tap Dictate once in: the Hospital pre-round editor, the Hospital Encounter box, the Ask AI sheet, the Nursing Home visit box

Then Each tap shows a message that names the microphone and how to allow / enable it; no crash, no raw browser error; the typed line is still there. Run 2 is the 'mic didn't start' class (Q6)

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): From U8: mustContain 'microphone' and the typed line; mustContainAny ['allow', 'enable', 'settings']; mustNotContain 'NotAllowedError', 'DOMException', 'undefined'

Where it ran: local newspec-c (new Playwright specs); test method PW · Playwright script; lane planned in the matrix: browser agent (blocked)

S17 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/EFS.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.

Triage (2026-10-14): 0 rows.

Environment: local — main e02167f → 25acd727 (10-15/16 re-tests), local stack (not a deployed build); run folder runs/2026-10-14-local, lane newspec-c.

Test method: PW · Playwright script; secondary: DEVICE · Real device (iOS / Android) — as classified in cases/test-methods.json, which says it runs on local; Source: newspec-c.

UAT item: EFS Empty & Failure States · Section: A5 · Cross-Cutting · Scenario: EFS/S17

Web: microphone blocked, and no microphone at all — every Dictate button explains how to enable it, typed text stays

Tickets: TFA-92570 Mobile: Capacitor wrap for App Store & Google Play (ready for qa); TFA-94745 Empty & Failure States (ready for qa)

New local lane newspec-c: status failed in newspec-c/results.json → failed · product (failed · product (the lane flagged a product issue; part of it is a known gap)).

Detail:

The oracle's cells all pass - 40/40 judged (newspec-c/vis-efs-s17-mic-blocked.spec.ts, desktop Chromium, two runs: getUserMedia rejected with NotAllowedError 'Permission denied', and with NotFoundError 'Requested device not found' / no capture device). In all four boxes - Hospital pre-round editor, Hospital Encounter box, Ask AI sheet, Nursing Home visit box - one Dictate tap after typing 'QA-EFS-17 typed before dictate.' shows 'Microphone access is blocked. Allow the microphone for this site (tap the lock icon in the address bar), or on iPhone/Android open Settings › Round Companion, then tap Dictate again.', the typed line stays in the box, no crash, no raw browser error. Failed only on the known B27 contradiction: in the Hospital pre-round editor the yellow 'Dictation done — review before saving' nudge shows together with the red microphone message in both runs, although nothing was dictated (UAT state 8 guidance). Record-only: with no microphone at all the wording still says 'blocked' / 'Allow the microphone' (Q6, suggestion); the pre-round editor's message is a plain div (Encounter and Nursing Home use role=alert, Ask AI the global role=alert banner). No recording, no model: the browser's own speech recognition was hidden so the app took the cloud engine physicians use (the account keeps its on-device marker), and ai/transcribe:prepareSession was held in the browser (4 calls per run, all 'hold', none reached the server); tripwire: no model call.

Product issue: With the microphone blocked (or missing), tapping Dictate in the Hospital pre-round editor shows 'Dictation done — review before saving' next to 'Microphone access is blocked…', telling the physician to review a dictation that never happened (B27).

Known gap (known): true

Evidence: 10 attached.

Dev run: skipped: set-aside — set-aside: iOS/Android; dictation by microphone/speaker (Quinn 2026-10-14) — Microphone: every step taps Dictate with the microphone blocked or absent.. This local result replaces that dev entry (the scenario appears once).
